developmentChanges.title: Experience-equivalency evidence score
developmentChanges.reason: When a vacancy says X months/years experience or equivalent, score direct transferable evidence separately from literal job-title tenure. This prevents practical service/troubleshooting experience from being discarded too early while still penalizing unsupported requirements.

developmentChanges.title: Fresh LinkedIn-to-canonical escalation
developmentChanges.reason: For a high-fit LinkedIn vacancy posted within 24 hours, immediately search the employer career site/job ID in the same run and retain promotion-ready status only when the canonical source or a still-active Apply signal can be established.
